tiebreakers.description: Tied animal highest on the food chain wins: Reptiles, then Cephalopods, then Fishes, then Crustaceans.

notes: family: area-majority-running-track. Game ends when the Asteroid card is played: finish the round, then a last Extinction, a last Survival, special-pawn VP, and a final scoring of every tile. Tile scoring (1st/2nd/3rd place by species count, 4th on Land 1 VP) is tracked during play; enter the final VP-track value. Evolution cards that reverse the food chain (Monotypic Habitat) reverse the tiebreak. 2-player option with two animals each is in the variant file.
